subject: Post-discovery: next steps & ops runbook for 30m demo
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@stratagen.com>, Sara Taylor <sara.taylor@stratagen.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-discovery: next steps & ops runbook for 30m demo

Hi Evan / Sara,

Thanks again for taking time today — good conversation and helpful signals around the evaluation priorities. Quick recap + proposed next step:

Summary (1 line each)
- Primary use case: inference at scale for multi-tenant SaaS workflows (low latency, cost controls).
- Top non-functional asks: predictable p99 latency, audit logs, and clear data residency options.
- Stakeholders: Evan (CTO) + infra/ops lead, Sara (product).

Proposed next step
- 30-minute product walkthrough (focused on serving, routing, and observability).
- Please pick the slot that works best for your team (all times PT):
  1) Mon Nov 22 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
  2) Tue Nov 23 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT
  3) Wed Nov 24 — 11:00–11:30 AM PT

Prep asks
- Can you confirm who will join from infra/ops? (we recommend an engineer who owns deployment/runbooks)
- Any must-see items for the demo (e.g., KV cache behavior, quantization tradeoffs, or audit log retention)?

I attached a short ops runbook (redwood-demo-runbook-v1.pdf) with the demo agenda, test account access, and infra checklist — should help your infra team decide who to include.

If you want a longer technical deep-dive instead we can extend to 60 minutes, otherwise the 30-min walk-through + follow-up workshop usually covers first-pass evaluation.

Best,
Michael Grant
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood-demo-runbook-v1.pdf (PDF)]

From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@stratagen.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Sara Taylor <sara.taylor@stratagen.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: next steps & ops runbook for 30m demo

Michael — thanks for the recap and for the runbook. Quick answers: we can do Nov 22 at 10:00 AM PT (option 1). Sara will join. I'll have one infra engineer (Rahul Kapoor) try to join — he might hop in partway.

Two quick items before we lock:
1) Do you have a short checklist we can give Rahul so he knows what to expect (ports, sample load, any credentials he needs)?
2) We run in AWS us-west-2 today; on the security side we need a SOC 2/AICPA overview and a note on data residency — is that in the runbook or separate?

Thanks — Evan
CTO, StrataGen

Thanks Evan — Nov 22 10:00 AM PT works for us; I’ll pencil that in as a provisional slot and send a calendar invite once Rahul confirms availability.

Neha — looping you in on the thread to answer Evan’s SOC2/data residency questions and flag anything we should surface during the demo.
Priyom — can you take point on the demo runbook and add a one-page infra checklist (things Rahul should know: network egress, default ports, demo scale commands, and sample payloads)? If you can attach the checklist and a short invite we’ll send both to Evan.

Evan / Sara — we’ll send the calendar invite + checklist by Thursday. If Rahul can’t join the full 30 minutes, Priyom and I can run the infra portion in the first 10–12 minutes and keep the rest for product flow.

Best,
Michael
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@stratagen.com>, Sara Taylor <sara.taylor@stratagen.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: next steps & ops runbook for 30m demo

Hi Evan / Sara — thanks for confirming the Nov 22 slot. Attaching two items: 1) a one-page infra checklist (short-runbook-infra-checklist.txt) and 2) the calendar invite for the 30-minute walkthrough (invite-20261122-30min.ics).

Key bullets from the checklist (TL;DR)
- Network: outbound egress to ports 443 (HTTPS) and 22 (SSH) for optional host debugging. No inbound tunnels required.
- Credentials: we will provide a short-lived demo API key during the session — no permanent keys needed.
- Scale: demo uses a synthetic 50 RPS profile — if you want a heavier run, let us know and we’ll provision extra nodes.
- Logs & compliance: we’ll show audit log examples in the observability tab; Neha will follow up with SOC2 evidence items outside the call.

Attachments: [attachment: short-runbook-infra-checklist.txt], [attachment: invite-20261122-30min.ics]

See you Nov 22 at 10:00 AM PT (I attached the calendar invite so you can add it directly). If Rahul needs a pre-call 15-minute sync, tell us and we’ll slot something on Nov 21 late-afternoon.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
